text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 49 vials of filgrastim 480 mcg/1.6 mL, providing 17.1 days of supply at a daily use of 2.9 vials. FDA's drug shortage list does not include filgrastim as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for Kashiv BioSciences, LLC (FEI 3011289655), the manufacturing plant identified on an Amneal product label, show a VAI classification on 2024-06-14 (known 2024-08-16) and a prior OAI classification on 2018-01-26 (known 2018-02-16). No FDA shortage posting exists for filgrastim.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 17 days. No national shortage is declared. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list today. The rule-based recommendation ranks Sandoz Inc. as the top alternate option.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer verifies current contract terms and pricing with Sandoz Inc. and places a replenishment order; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer confirms availability and lead times with Tanvex BioPharma USA, Inc. as a secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer requests plant information for Accord BioPharma Inc., Amgen Inc., and Cipla USA Inc. products to assess supply chain transparency; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer monitors FDA communications daily for any future shortage listing; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: Initiating conservation protocols or therapeutic substitutions at this time; clinical changes are for the treating clinicians and the committee.
